instruction: Fix `list_by_extension` in `fileops/scan.py` so the extension match is case-insensitive. Searching for `"txt"` currently misses files whose names are uppercase (e.g. `report.TXT`).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/fileops/scan.py b/fileops/scan.py
--- a/fileops/scan.py
+++ b/fileops/scan.py
@@ -13,6 +13,6 @@
     names = []
     for name in os.listdir(directory):
         full = os.path.join(directory, name)
-        if os.path.isfile(full) and name.endswith("." + ext):
+        if os.path.isfile(full) and name.lower().endswith("." + ext):
             names.append(name)
     return sorted(names)
